newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse recovers, high-caps up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse recovers, high-caps up.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse recovered its poise on Wednesday on a spate of foreign interest.

"We thought we were in for a longer string of falls, but investors, especially foreign ones, were once again very active," a trader said. "Nobody seems to be affected by Romania's failed bid to gain first-wave entry to NATO."
"The market's heavyweights were once again in focus, with buying pressure towards the end of trading driving six of them to higher closing quotes," said a broker.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched up 0.8, 1.07 and 0.65 percent respectively from the previous session.
The average prices of 26 stocks went up and 12 edged down. Six companies had no trade and two were suspended.
Volume thinned to 2.5 million shares from 3.8 million in light supply, with turnover falling to 12.7 billion lei from 19.4 billion.
Chemical plants and pharmaceuticals companies revigorated from Tuesday's losses.
Oltchim chemical plant and Azomures fertiliser maker firmed 250 lei each to 5,250 and 4,600.
Antibiotice and Terapia pharmaceuticals ended 450 and respectively 800 lei up at 8,600 and 11,200.
The only high-cap to close lower was fertiliser maker Sofert SOFE.BX, which lost 3,700 lei to 34,500.
The second tier traded mixed, with focus staying on Armatura industrial fittings maker, which had the bulk of volume in this section. It closed 350 lei weaker at 7,450.
